flop_count_operators: run flop_count_operators on a detectron2 model to get GFLOP counts per operator
activation_count_operators: run activation_count_operators on a detectron2 model to count activations per operator
FlopCountAnalysis: build a FlopCountAnalysis instance for a detectron2 model to analyze FLOPs with advanced options
parameter_count: run parameter_count on a detectron2 model to get the total number of parameters
find_unused_parameters: run find_unused_parameters on a training model to list parameters not contributing to the loss
